name: Pine Knoll Day Camp
description_short: Town recreation day camp in East Longmeadow running eight weekly sessions, with a half day option for preschoolers and a counselor in training program. Groups swim twice a day in the camp pool and Fridays bring themed special events and a free pizza lunch.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non refundable; cancellations before May 22 carry a $15 fee, and no refunds are granted after May 22.
swim_waterfront_notes: Each group has two swim periods a day in the camp pool with certified lifeguards; campers 6 and up take a weekly swim test for the deep end. Pre K and kindergarten children are not swim tested.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Pine Knoll Day Camp Parent Handbook 2026, on the town recreation department's registration site. Monday to Friday 9:00 am to 4:00 pm; before care 7:30 to 9:00 am and after care 4:00 to 5:00 pm. 2026 costs: one week sessions $295 non resident ($280 resident); 8 week option $1,935 non resident ($1,920 resident); Pre K half day $165 non resident ($150 resident); before care $50 per week non resident ($35 resident); after care $40 per week non resident ($25 resident). Weekly price is the non resident rate per the house rule pending Andrew's decision. Bring lunch; cheese pizza free on Fridays. CIT program for youth who have completed grades 6 to 9. The handbook does not give the camp's street address (328 North Main St is the Recreation Department office) or an age range.
